reviews.text: Daniel, it's a real pleasure to know that you rated your experience with the highest rating. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We'd be delighted to welcome you back anytime.

I've been helped twice by Carmen, once for my fish and once for my Chihuahua puppy. She's a wonderful employee—patient, dedicated, caring, and attentive to everything I need, even before I ask.
Overall, this is my favorite pet store. We'll definitely continue to be loyal customers.

How thoughtful of you, Juan Carlos, to take a moment to give us the highest rating. We greatly appreciate your support and trust in Kiwoko. We hope to continue exceeding your expectations with every visit.
Carmen helped us; she was exceptional and very professional, and gave us excellent advice.

Razvandicoot, your feedback encourages us to keep going with enthusiasm. It's a pleasure to know that our efforts to offer the best service and products for you and your furry companions are appreciated. Thank you for taking a moment to share your experience with us.

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review, Carol. It's incredibly motivating to know that your experience with us has been so satisfactory. We hope to continue meeting your expectations in the future.
Very good service
It's always a pleasure to receive such positive feedback from our customers. We're delighted to hear that your experience with us was five stars. We hope to see you soon at Kiwoko, Ana.

September 2026 Update: I'm trying to book an appointment with Ana, but she's not showing up anywhere. I'd like to know if she no longer works with you.

Thank you.

This is the second time I've taken Lua to the grooming service at La Vaguada, and I have nothing but praise for Ana. Even though I have other groomers closer to home, I haven't found the kindness and care with which Ana treats my dog ​​anywhere else. She listens patiently and dedicates the necessary time; you don't feel like you have to rush out. Instead, she's fully committed to each service, with a very personal touch.

The first time I went, my dog ​​had just been rescued, dirty, matted, and scared, and Ana treated her with so much love and gentleness. She made her look like a completely different dog. This time, a few months later, she remembered her perfectly and treated her with the same love and dedication as before. And she did exactly as I had asked. Without a doubt, even though it's not the center closest to my home, I will definitely make another appointment with Ana.

Today we took our long-haired Yorkshire Terrier to the groomer and they left him looking like a rat. We found him shaved and on top of that, they charged us extra for detangling. I also have to say that it wasn't the usual groomer because Ana did a great job. We're very unhappy and if Ana isn't there, I won't be taking him back. They did a terrible job on our dog!
I'm giving it one star because I can't give it zero. The cashier's service was terrible and she was disrespectful.
Unprofessional staff with little knowledge about the products and animals they sell
My only complaint was the elderly lady at the checkout; she was very unpleasant.
We greatly appreciate your feedback, Rivas. It encourages us to continue offering the best for our customers and their pets. We hope to see you again soon in our stores.
Very poor staff organization. There's always a queue at the checkout, and you spend 15 minutes waiting to buy anything. The staff are always doing something else but working the till.
Ana has been very patient and loving with Chula, our mini Schnauzer puppy.

A great experience at Kiwoko!
Gloria, the cashier, was very attentive and friendly with my purchases. I always enjoy visiting the store because of the excellent service and the high-quality products they have for our pets. It's so nice to find such friendly and helpful people!
I'll be back to buy more things for my cats and my hamster 🤍

I was going to say that the service was wonderful and my son was delighted seeing the animals. They even gave me advice about fish this week, but then I saw the previous comment and I don't understand how someone can put a newly purchased fish into an aquarium without acclimating it first, especially after an hour's journey, which is supposedly a very long time... It's unbelievable that people have to put up with these people, honestly. In my case, they gave me information about neon tetras because I want to start an aquarium after an accident during a move where they all arrived dead, unfortunately. They were incredibly patient with me even though the store was quite busy. I don't understand how people buy animals without having even the most basic knowledge. This is for that Erica Benitez Carpio woman; the ignorance is incredible. Luckily, I've always been helped at several Kiwoko stores I've been to. Some are more patient than others, of course, but I've always left satisfied at this one.

A photo of my poor Tetras

I'm giving it one star, but I could easily give it less if possible.

We bought a telescope goldfish an hour ago, and as soon as we got home and put it in our aquarium, which is in perfect condition and already has other fish, the new fish died. It died within five minutes.

We're very disappointed.

I really love Kiwoko, and I always enjoy visiting when I go with my dog, Ada.

The staff are incredibly professional and friendly. They're very helpful and recommend the best products for your pet.

The store has practically everything, from different brands. I like to buy hygiene products (wipes and cologne), although I also buy Scheir brand canned food.
